translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wach mokor nibiro timore ne Kush

content.text: Inine malit in piny man-gi bede
mag aore mamor mag Kush,
ma oro jootene ka ngʼado nam
gi yiedhi mohondhi gi oundho.
Dhiuru, un joote ma tiendgi yot ir oganda ma roboche kendo ma dendgi poth,
moluor kuonde duto, oganda ma tokgi tek mawacho dhok mopogore,
kendo ma pinygi aore opogo migawo.
Un ji duto manie piny, un mudak e piny,
ka bandech lweny otingʼ malo ewi gode,
to ununene kendo ka turumbete noywagi to unuwinje.
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wachona:
Abiro lingʼ thi kendo nangʼichi gie kar dakna mana,
kaka piny kwe mos ka chiengʼ
liet kendo kaka rumbi mar tho moko ndalo keyo.
E kinde ma keyo podi ma mzabibu osemoyo
kendo ma olembgi osechiek,
enongʼadgi oko kod ratongʼ
kendo enongʼad bedene molawore.
Giduto nowegi ne achudhe mae gode kendo ne le mag bungu,
winy nochamgi e ndalo mag oro duto,
ka le mag bungu to chamogi e ndalo chwiri duto.

content: E kindeno chiwo noter e nyim Jehova Nyasaye Maratego

content.text: koa kuom oganda ma roboche,
kendo ma dendgi poth, moluor kuonde duto,
oganda ma tokgi tek mawacho dhok mopogore
kendo ma pinygi aore opogo.

content: Chiwogi nokel ewi Got Sayun kama Nying Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nitie.
